incidents.name: Euler Finance
incidents.notes: Euler main proxy: donateToReserves (eIP-14) skipped the liquidity check, enabling self-liquidation at a discount. Euler installs code as modules on the proxy (InstallerInstallModule), not via EIP-1967 Upgraded: the EToken module carrying donateToReserves went live onchain 2022-08-18T16:01:33Z, and the last module install of any kind before the exploit was 2023-01-06T16:25:59Z, which is what the age is measured from.

sources.ref: onchain review (RPC only): Euler main proxy 0x27182842E098f60e3D576794A5bFFb0777E025d3 created 2021-11-26T04:13:05Z at block 13687582; eth_getLogs for EIP-1967 Upgraded (topic 0xbc7cd75a20ee27fd9adebab32041f755214dbc6bffa90cc0225b39da2e5c2d3b) over [13687582, 16818931] returns 0 logs. Code changes go through the Installer module and are recorded by InstallerInstallModule(uint256 moduleId, address moduleImpl, bytes32 gitCommit) (topic 0x15fc136599039b272cb44c0ace0b099754f2656d1d52691b99c9e348662c805a) emitted by the proxy itself: 44 installs between creation and the incident. The last install strictly before the first exploit tx 0xc310a0affe2169d1f6feec1c63dbc7f7c62a887fa48795d327d4d2da2d6b111d (block 16817996, 2023-03-13T08:50:59Z) is moduleId 2000506 -> 0x89e8f69c302d352d37de10019a69df4f7f959bef at block 16348923, 2023-01-06T16:25:59Z (tx 0x000f80a4884b72ff3814f92b5eb594870b025bd7ae840d9d5df426c2f1f42235). The preceding installs are 2022-12-16T14:38:11Z moduleId 4 Governance -> 0xe83b69edfd12e477fe47152c0e1d65576b91a1cf, 2022-12-01T14:14:11Z moduleId 2000505, 2022-10-18T14:55:35Z moduleId 7 SwapHub -> 0xc57d9e4a688551d99645b49126e93589d4b478c8, 2022-08-31T14:53:51Z moduleId 2000504, 2022-08-18T16:01:33Z moduleId 500000 EToken -> 0xbb0d4bb654a21054af95456a3b29c63e8d1f4c0a (block 15365947). The previously recorded date 2022-07-28 (the eIP-14 vote) matches no onchain install: scanning the installed EToken implementations for the donateToReserves selector 0x36f022aa, it is absent from 0x2d2f24c7 (2021-11-29), 0x03601edc (2021-12-10), 0x1245f078 (2022-03-28), 0xee385a1e (2022-04-10) and 0x196fdd95 (2022-08-04) and first appears in 0xbb0d4bb654a21054af95456a3b29c63e8d1f4c0a installed 2022-08-18T16:01:33Z, so even the flaw-introducing change is 21 days later than the recorded date (measuring from it would give 17870307s / 206.8d). Age is measured from the last pre-incident install per the dataset rule. The two installs at 2023-03-13T10:05:23Z and 11:44:23Z (moduleIds 500000/500001 pointed at 486-byte stubs, gitCommit '0x1') are the post-exploit emergency shutdown; they fall after the 08:50:59Z exploit but before this row's noon incidentTimestamp and are excluded. Correction: 19699200s (228.0d) -> 5686441s (65.8d).

incidents.documentedLastChange: 2023-01-06T16:25:59Z (block 16348923, tx 0x000f80a4884b72ff3814f92b5eb594870b025bd7ae840d9d5df426c2f1f42235): last InstallerInstallModule(uint256,address,bytes32) on the Euler proxy before the 2023-03-13T08:50:59Z exploit, installing moduleId 2000506 -> 0x89e8f69c302d352d37de10019a69df4f7f959bef; the EToken module first carrying donateToReserves (selector 0x36f022aa) was installed earlier, 2022-08-18T16:01:33Z, block 15365947
